title: Gusto pricing - $35-$180 base/month plus $6-$22 per person
clean_text: As of March 1, 2026, Gusto raised its Simple plan to $49/month base plus $6/person (up from $40 base). Plus starts at $80/month plus $12/person, and Premium starts at $180/month plus $22/person, with Premium adding a dedicated Customer Success Manager, certified HR expert access, and priority support. A Contractor Only plan (no W-2 employees) starts at $35/month plus $6/contractor. Several optional modules cost extra, adding $10-$30 per employee per month depending on plan level.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, base fee plus per-person
